author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A hospital in Sundsvall, central Sweden, used an unusual cooling system that stored winter snow for use during summer. The snow was kept in a large, insulated storage area and its meltwater was circulated through the hospital to provide cooling. Researchers found that insulation was essential, as unprotected snow would melt by mid-June. The study showed that stored snow could meet the hospital's cooling demand from May to August.

description: Starlink satellites are now helping scientists map Earth's upper atmosphere. Researchers used orbital data from Starlink to estimate thermosphere density. author: DHRUV YADAV
description: The Army has established its first dedicated drone battalion, the Baaz Battalion, along the western front. This new unit will operate under the Vajra Corps, overseeing sensitive border areas in northern Punjab. The Army is integrating more drones across various units for combat and support roles. Infantry battalions are receiving Ashni platoons, and artillery will induct Divyastra batteries.
title: From border watch to deep strikes: Army raises first Baaz drone battalion

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
title: Jaishankar to visit Russia on August 23-24; focus on trade, scientific cooperation

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Rishabh Pant's comeback to the Delhi Capitals ignites discussions regarding future captaincy. Former batsman Wasim Jaffer advises Pant to concentrate on regaining his batting form rather than taking on leadership duties just yet. Meanwhile, Axar Patel's captaincy is under the microscope following a lackluster season, with KL Rahul emerging as a possible alternative for the captaincy role.
title: ‘Say no to captaincy’: Ex-India cricketer’s big warning for Rishabh Pant

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: New SIM card regulations will take effect from August twenty-fourth. Telecom operators must identify and inform customers exceeding their mobile connection limits. Initially, verification will occur post-activation, with a move to real-time checks by November. Subscribers in most of India can hold nine connections, while others have six. This system aims to prevent individuals from obtaining connections beyond the prescribed limit.
title: SIM Card rules changing: What you can do and cannot do after August 24

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Rahul Dravid advocates for a well-balanced strategy for aspiring cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. He points out the crucial role of red-ball cricket alongside white-ball fixtures in a player's development. Such diverse training is anticipated to aid Sooryavanshi's growth. Dravid encourages patience as the youngster starts his professional path, reaffirming the sport's dedication to cultivating future Test cricket players.
title: ‘Sooryavanshi hasn’t played as much red-ball cricket’: Dravid’s blunt assessment

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: ‘Bribe to suppress rape case’ allegation: Mann’s wife sends notice to ex-judge

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Yogi, Akhilesh, Mayawati given Rs 10 lakh bulletproof jackets ahead of UP polls

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Alia Bhatt has officially joined the cast of the highly anticipated Tumbbad 2. She was recently spotted on the film's sets, adding excitement to the production. The actress's casting marks her first full-fledged venture into the horror genre. Filming is underway for sequences set around a river and an old fort. Tumbbad 2 is scheduled for a December 3, 2027 theatrical release.
title: Alia Bhatt spotted on 'Tumbbad 2' sets; begins shooting for first horror role - pics

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Launched in 2000, Cornell University's lake source cooling system exemplifies sustainable innovation, utilizing the icy waters of Cayuga Lake to meet the campus's cooling demands. This groundbreaking initiative, which commenced construction in 1999, achieved an extraordinary eighty-five percent cut in annual energy consumption, positioning the university at the forefront of eco-friendly solutions for the future.
title: Cornell cools campus with 39°F water from 250 ft below Cayuga Lake, cuts energy 85%

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Global Capability Centres have drastically increased office leasing activity throughout India, particularly in Bengaluru, Pune, Delhi NCR, and Mumbai. These hubs represent a significant portion of national office space uptake. The positive demand for office spaces has resulted in a continuous decrease in vacancy rates, showcasing the robust confidence in India's prolonged economic growth prospects.
title: GCCs keep India’s office market buzzing, Bengaluru takes the lead

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Elon Musk issued productivity rules to Tesla staff in an April 2018 email. He urged employees to eliminate unnecessary meetings and avoid complicated jargon. Musk advised leaving meetings where value is not being added by attendees. Communication should travel directly, bypassing strict chains of command. He emphasized using common sense to guide actions and improve company execution.
title: Elon Musk took authority away from Tesla managers and handed it to employees

author: PRATYUSH RAJ
description: Delhi opener Sanat Sangwan was one of the breakout stars of the 2025-26 Ranji Trophy season. The 25-year-old amassed 828 runs at an average of 69, including three hundreds, and is gearing up for the next big challenge of his career in the upcoming Duleep Trophy, starting from Sunday at the BCCI's Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru.
title: Duleep Trophy: Sanat Sangwan, a Kohli & Lewis Hamilton fan, ready for next challenge

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: 'Arrogance brings downfall': Jayant Chaudhary on Akhilesh's 'chavanni' remark

author: ABHAY
description: A software engineer died after a family dispute in Nihal Vihar.  His wife's relatives allegedly assaulted him severely on Friday.  Police have detained four individuals in connection with the incident.  The engineer and his wife had been married for three and a half years.  An investigation is underway to determine the exact circumstances of the assault.
title: 31-year-old Adobe techie beaten to death by wife’s family in Delhi

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Trade negotiations between the United States and Canada fell apart after a three-day face-off. Canada called a halt to discussions, criticizing the US for presenting proposals that were both unfair and detrimental. In a dramatic move, the US introduced hefty tariffs on Canadian goods, prompting Canada to respond with an equal retaliatory measure. This failure to reach an agreement casts uncertainty over North American trade relations moving forward.
title: Trade standoff: Trump's 50% tariff kicks in; Carney vows 'dollar-for-dollar' response

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 1921, a lighthouse from New Jersey was relocated to the banks of the Hudson River. Although it once played a crucial role in navigation, the construction of the George Washington Bridge overshadowed its significance. However, a beloved children's book published in 1942 turned the lighthouse into a cultural treasure. Thanks to public protests in 1951, the structure was preserved, becoming a beloved emblem of childhood memories.
title: In 1921, New York moved a New Jersey lighthouse to the Hudson; a book saved it

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: India and the United Kingdom advanced their defence partnership during a key consultative meeting. Both nations agreed to expand military-to-military engagement and joint exercises across their armed forces. Maritime security in the Indo-Pacific region was a significant topic of discussion between the two countries. The Defence Industrial Roadmap will drive co-development and co-production of advanced defence platforms. This collaboration aims to enhance technological autonomy and strategic depth for India.
title: Joint R&D, military engagement & Indo-Pacific security: India, UK deepen defence partnership

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Why Canada suspended US trade talks despite Trump's ‘good relationship’ with Carney

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu fiercely criticized Turkey's President Erdogan after Ankara sought an Interpol notice.  Erdogan's government requested the notice concerning an interception of a Gaza aid flotilla.  Netanyahu's office labeled Erdogan an antisemitic dictator with numerous accusations.  This exchange escalates existing tensions between the two nations over Syria.  Both countries are engaged in a diplomatic and legal dispute over these matters.
title: 'Antisemitic dictator': Netanyahu slams Erdogan after Turkey seeks Interpol action

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan encourages founders to spend significantly on AI tokens. He believes this approach grants access to future AI capabilities today. Tan suggests using AI agents for tasks and then documenting successful workflows. This method turns instructions into repeatable automated processes for businesses. While some debate this "tokenmaxxing" approach, Tan sees it as an investment.
title: Y Combinator CEO has a message for founders worried about burning AI tokens

author: TNN
description: A massive fire erupted at a steel plant in Ramgarh, Jharkhand, on Friday night. Three people are dead and one person sustained injuries in the incident. The blaze began in the main control room and rapidly spread throughout the facility. Many employees were present on the premises when the devastating flames broke out. Authorities are currently working to confirm the identities and exact number of casualties.
title: 3 killed in fire at steel plant in Jharkhand's Ramgarh

author: GAURAV GUPTA
description: Prabath Jayasuriya shares insights on his long-awaited Test debut and impressive performances with the Sri Lankan team. Following a disappointing first Test, he emphasizes the need for more defined bowling strategies. Identifying the likes of Joe Root, Kane Williamson, and Steve Smith as tough opponents, he remains optimistic about Sri Lanka's chances of reaching the World Test Championship final.
title: ‘Manav Suthar can become one of the best bowlers in the world’: Jayasuriya

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Nitin Nabin led the BJP's new national team in their first meeting.  They discussed upcoming assembly elections and grassroots outreach efforts.  The party unveiled a 65-member team with many new faces appointed.  Key positions saw Vasundhara Raje and Ram Madhav named vice presidents.  Piyush Goyal returned as treasurer while other roles were also filled.
title: BJP chief Nitin Nabin holds first meet with new team ahead of polls

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
title: Myanmar military strike on Buddhist monastery kills 14, including three women

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: MP Lingamaneni Ramesh stated his son is cooperating fully with the investigation.  The accident tragically claimed the life of a 26-year-old woman in Hyderabad.  His son immediately took the injured woman to the hospital after the incident.  Three medical tests conducted on his son have reportedly returned negative results.  The family expressed condolences and faith in the legal process to reveal facts.
title: Aston Martin crash: ‘My son took her to hospital,’ says MP Lingamaneni Ramesh

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The National Investigation Agency conducted raids at two locations in Anantnag. These searches occurred in Bijbehara and Dooru areas of south Kashmir. NIA officers, with police and CRPF support, searched residential houses. The agency also raided SICOP in Bijbehara as part of its investigation. Details regarding the outcome of these searches are currently awaited.
title: J&K: NIA raids residential houses in Anantnag as part of terror probe

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Apple has decided to streamline its operations, resulting in layoffs of over two hundred employees from the Siri and Vision Pro divisions. The adjustments within the Vision Pro team involve reductions in gaming and immersive video content production as Apple shifts focus. Meanwhile, the Siri AI architecture undergoes a major overhaul, necessitating new skill sets, reflecting the company's strategic pivot towards smart glasses over its current headset model.
title: Apple layoffs hit employees across teams; company confirms job cuts

author: TOI NEWS DESK
title: Sambhal violence: Interpol issues Red Corner Notice against mastermind Shariq Satha

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Michael Vaughan expressed serious concern over Pakistan's recent Test performance.  England secured a comprehensive innings victory in the opening match.  Pakistan's batting collapsed twice, showing a lack of confidence.  Vaughan noted tactical shortcomings and a skill gap between the teams.  The defeat marked a new era for England under captain Root.
title: ‘Blown away and hammered’: Ex-England captain says Pakistan lack ‘spirit’

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: A banker allegedly murdered his wife and sister in a double murder-suicide incident.  Divya Mishra sought a Rs 1.5 crore financial settlement in her divorce proceedings.  Strained relations over Manas Bajpayi's sister, Sheeba, also contributed to the marital discord.  Police are investigating the killings as a pre-planned sequence of events.  Digital evidence and witness statements are being analyzed to establish the motive.
title: Lucknow double murder-suicide twist: Wife's Rs 1.5cr demand may have led to killings

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In response to unfair trade terms imposed by the United States, Canada has decided to suspend its trade negotiations. With significant tariffs on Canadian imports set to take effect at midnight, Prime Minister Carney announced that Canada will retaliate with equivalent tariffs. Negotiators are being recalled to Ottawa, reflecting the uncertainty in discussions as Canada now shifts its focus towards boosting domestic economic growth and seeking new international trade opportunities.
title: 'Unfair': Canada suspends US trade talks after Trump's 'deal moving along' remark

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Vivienne Jolie-Pitt is legally dropping her father's surname, publishing court notices.  Her siblings Zahara and Maddox have also pursued similar name changes.  Shiloh Jolie-Pitt was the first to officially remove the 'Pitt' surname.  Vivienne has been professionally using only the 'Jolie' surname.  These changes occur amid ongoing estrangement from their father, Brad Pitt.
title: Brad & Angelina's daughter, Vivienne posts ad to officially drop 'Pitt' surname

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Awarapan 2 maintained steady box office collections on its second Friday. The romantic crime thriller recorded a small decline in its Day 8 earnings. Its India net collection is now approaching the Rs 120 crore mark. Worldwide gross collections for the film have reached Rs 169.17 crore. The second weekend will be crucial for the film's future performance.
title: Awarapan 2 day 8: Emraan Hashmi film earns Rs 5.5cr in India, Rs 169cr worldwide

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Iranian President Pezeshkian seeks an end to the ongoing conflict, citing national strength and dignity.  He defended a past agreement against domestic criticism while military leaders warned of retaliation.  Oman and Iran discussed resuming dialogue as the Strait of Hormuz remains a critical flashpoint.  US President Trump indicated Iran was not ready for a suitable agreement.  Washington plans new sanctions, which Iran and China have criticized as ineffective.
title: 'We are in position of power': Iran's Pezeshkian seeks end to US war, claims victory

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Mitchell Starc took five wickets in the first session against Bangladesh. He surpassed Dale Steyn on the list of Test wicket-takers. Starc's remarkable figures were 5-11 from nine overs. This performance came after Bangladesh won the opening Test match. Australia aims to level the series in the second Test.
title: Mitchell Starc unleashes carnage on Bangladesh, storms past Dale Steyn

author: MEGHNA DHULIA
description: Delhi Police detained several protesters gathered at Jantar Mantar for an anti-reservation demonstration. Security was tightened around the protest site amid a heavy turnout of demonstrators. Protesters demanded economic criteria take precedence over caste for government support and reservation. The campaign gained significant traction online through a popular social media page. Authorities stated no permission was granted for the Jantar Mantar assembly.
title: Over 50 detained at Jantar Mantar; protesters demand reservation for poor, not castes

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Yash's film 'Toxic' shows strong advance booking numbers for its upcoming release.  The Kannada version leads the advance sales, contributing significantly to the total.  Karnataka is the top region for advance bookings, reflecting the actor's home market.  International markets like the USA are also showing interest in the film.  The movie has received an 'A' certificate in India and an 18 rating in the UK.
title: 'Toxic' movie's advance booking nears Rs 20 crore presales

author: ABHAY
description: Delhi Police registered a case after Rahul Gandhi staged a dharna.  He demanded an FIR for pellet injuries suffered by Sahil Lochab.  Gandhi reached the police station with Lochab and his mother.  Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and other leaders later joined the protest.  Senior police officers were also met by the Congress leaders.
title: Pellet injuries: FIR filed after Rahul Gandhi sits on dharna

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In a groundbreaking move, China has launched an extensive automotive recall, impacting 4.3 million vehicles across multiple manufacturers including Tesla. Safety regulators have raised alarms about the potential difficulty occupants may face in opening doors during emergency situations. Tesla is responsible for almost three million of these recalls, focusing on solutions such as software enhancements and additional warning labels.
title: 4.3m vehicles recalled in China over safety risks; Tesla accounts for 2.98m

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: At least 2 killed, several injured in reactor blast at Telangana pharma unit

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: An Indian national faces charges for his alleged role as a money mule.  He was arrested in Canada while attempting to flee to Qatar.  The scheme targeted elderly victims and involved millions of dollars.  Investigators believe he collected cash and gold from nine victims.  Canadian authorities arrested him at Toronto Pearson International Airport.
title: Cash, gold & elderly victims: How Indian-origin man became 'money mule' in $7.5m US scam

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: In India women's first match of the second round of the FIH World Cup againt the co-hosts Netherlands on Friday in Amstelveen, India walked out in saffron. The Netherlands walked out in blue.
title: Co-host Netherlands wear blue on blue turf, India play in saffron in Hockey WC

author: MOHAMMED AKHEF
description: An eighteen-year-old died after jumping from a hill when his parents refused him a mobile phone. His parents also lost their lives while attempting to rescue him from the steep cliff. Rescuers and family members made frantic efforts for nearly three hours to save the teenager. The father moved towards his son in the final moments and both fell.
title: 1 fall, 3 deaths at Maharashtra hill: How teen's iPhone demand ended in tragedy

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A 21-year-old school dropout who rejected university for a carpentry apprenticeship now earns up to £50,000 a year. Hugo Helms says his trade offers financial independence and peace of mind from AI replacing his work. He is saving for his first home, runs a business supporting apprentices and hopes to reach £100,000 within five years.
title: At 21, school dropout earns £50,000 after choosing carpentry over university

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Travis Kelce might be one of the most popula athletes in the world but he had to seek professional help which had changed his life overnight.
title: Travis Kelce reveals why he sought professional help after life changed overnight

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Awarapan 2 maintained steady box office collections on its second Friday. The romantic crime thriller recorded a small decline in its Day 8 earnings. Its India net collection is now approaching the Rs 120 crore mark. Worldwide gross collections for the film have reached Rs 169.17 crore. The second weekend will be crucial for the film's future performance.
title: Awarapan 2 day 8: Emraan Hashmi film earns Rs 5.5cr in India, Rs 169cr worldwide

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Pakistan achieved an unwanted Test record by losing their opening wicket for zero runs in both innings. This rare feat occurred for the seventh time in their Test match history. England's bowlers dominated the match, securing an innings victory inside three days. Ollie Robinson and Josh Tongue were instrumental in Pakistan's batting collapses. The result gave England a lead in the ongoing three-match series.
title: Headingley horror! Pakistan create unwanted Test record in crushing defeat

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Canada gurdwara stabbing: 2 injured in Edmonton, suspect held day after prison release

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The fierce nor'easter of 1962 became a pivotal moment for Robert Moses as he sought to introduce a highway on Fire Island. Yet, the local populace and property owners stood firm against the initiative, worried for their environment and community’s future. Their activism prompted valuable support from the federal government, leading to the creation of Fire Island National Seashore in 1964, which has preserved the island's unspoiled setting.
title: Fire Island highway plan failed; 17 communities remain inside national seashore

author: U SUDHAKAR REDDY
description: Police seized the Aston Martin involved in a fatal Madhapur road accident for inspection.  The accused, son of an MP, tested negative for alcohol and drugs.  Authorities defended their decision not to arrest the accused based on legal guidelines.  Further action will depend on the evidence gathered during the ongoing investigation.  The MVI report and forensic findings are crucial for the next steps.
title: Hyderabad crash: Police defend no-arrest call; Rs 6 crore Aston Martin seized

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Invasive rats were removed from Midway Atoll, which had devastated native seabird populations.  Bonin petrel numbers surged from under five thousand to over one hundred thirty-five thousand pairs.  This eradication effort also allowed native vegetation to recover and stabilize the fragile islands.  However, invasive house mice later emerged as a new threat to nesting albatrosses.  Strict biosecurity measures now protect this vital Pacific sanctuary from further introductions.
title: Midway Atoll eradicated invasive rats; petrels rebounded to 135,000+ pairs

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A couple bought a renovated 19th-century church near Bristol for £490,000, calling it their dream home despite its former crypt basement. Mary says she has heard whistling and footsteps around the basement and has been unsettled by a hymn board that repeatedly falls. Tombstones also remain over the stove, adding to the property's eerie history.
title: A couple bought a £490,000 converted church despite its 'haunted' crypt

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry's foundation has received a major $200,000 donation as the star player gears up for the new season.
title: Stephen and Ayesha Curry's foundation gets major $200,000 boost

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The successful eradication of feral pigs from Santa Cruz Island, initiated in 2005 and completed by 2006, played a pivotal role in the recovery of the island fox. Once teetering on the brink of extinction, the island fox population rebounded dramatically. In 2016, federal authorities celebrated the milestone of removing three island fox subspecies from the endangered list, marking the fastest recovery of any mammal under the Endangered Species Act.
title: 5,036 pigs removed from Santa Cruz Island, foxes rebounded from 70 to 2,100

author: KORIDE MAHESH
description: Several opposition chief ministers and ministers have faced foreign travel clearance denials.  Telangana CM Revanth Reddy's recent rejection is not an isolated incident.  Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann and West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee also experienced similar rejections.  Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal and Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan were also denied foreign trip approvals.  These rejections highlight the MEA's role in granting political clearance for official visits.
title: Revanth Reddy not first CM to be denied MEA nod for foreign visit

author: SHILPA PHADNIS
title: Cognizant notifies individuals of data breach, offers $1 m identity theft cover
